name: Multi-view Wavelet Footprint Permutation
definition: A technique to render volume data from multiple viewing directions by reusing precomputed footprints of basis functions (types 1-7) through permutation and negation, avoiding recalculation for each view.
summary: Multi-view Wavelet Footprint Permutation renders multiple volume views simultaneously by reusing precomputed footprints via wavelet symmetry permutations, eliminating redundant splat computation overhead.
